limitations: Validation is a query-disjoint sample of training triplets, not the official MS MARCO benchmark.
Known positives are limited to this pinned triplet source, not the complete MS MARCO qrels.
Static upstream BM25 negatives are used; this pipeline does not mine the full 8.8M-passage corpus.
Query grouping retains digits and punctuation; paraphrases may still cross the split.
Document normalization preserves case; case variants and semantic duplicates are not merged.
Documents may appear in both partitions; this is query-disjoint, not document-disjoint validation.
The data terms differ from the repository code license; do not assume permission to redistribute text.

normalization.document: Unicode NFKC; collapse all whitespace; preserve case, punctuation and digits
normalization.document_id: doc_ + SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical document text
normalization.query_group: Document normalization then Unicode casefold; preserve punctuation and digits
normalization.query_id: query_ + SHA256 of UTF-8 normalized query group text

protocol.representative: Smallest canonical triplet SHA256, then zero-based source row index
protocol.sampling: Globally smallest SHA256(version + newline + seed + newline + normalized-query SHA256)
